prs.cluster_pick_reason: #1996 introduces a dedicated acceptsMediaType() parser that implements proper media-range parsing per RFC 7231 semantics: it splits each Accept entry on ';', checks q-parameters and excludes entries with q=0, and matches type/subtype (including wildcard support). #2046 instead replaces the strict check with a plain string .includes('application/json') test, which has no handling for q=0 exclusion or wildcard media ranges (e.g. 'application/json;q=0' or 'application/*' would be mishandled). Same underlying bug, but #1996's fix covers more Accept-header edge cases than #2046's inline substring check.
